name: Compound (Comptroller COMP distribution)
summary: Proposal 62 changed the supplier and borrower COMP-index initialization checks from greater-than-or-equal to strict greater-than. Accounts whose market index equalled compInitialIndex remained uninitialized, so a later claim calculated rewards from index zero and transferred vastly excess COMP.

loss.notes: Contemporaneous analysis reports approximately $80 million in excess COMP distributed through the Proposal 62 bug. The structured 91,170.351328585460017120 COMP component is the exact transfer in the code-age anchor transaction and provides a $27.30 million onchain cross-check.

ageReset.description: Proposal 62 emitted the last pre-incident NewImplementation(address,address) event and selected the defect-bearing Comptroller implementation.

sources.note: Reviewed the exploit receipt and call trace, exact COMP transfer, Unitroller deployment, verified Unitroller/Comptroller source, Proposal 64 analysis, Proposal 62 execution receipt, all 11 NewImplementation events from deployment through the incident, implementation slot 2, pre-exploit implementation runtime hash, and the incident-time COMP price observation. The anchored claimComp call transferred exactly 91,170.351328585460017120 COMP from Unitroller to 0x309d413391e975b553b7b8d19bc11f8a6c2eb889. At the nearest preceding DefiLlama observation, 1,291 seconds before the claim, COMP was $299.4068016365511, valuing this transaction's transfer at $27,297,023.30. Proposal 62's strict-greater-than initialization checks left accounts at index zero when the market index equalled compInitialIndex, causing later claims to accrue from zero. Proposal 62 transaction 0xc5098f8fb149262d7f26d32c0642e0e8bee5383d9df9c4988070f63a23cb9912 emitted NewImplementation at log 117 and selected 0x374abb8ce19a73f2c4efad642bda76c797f19233. That was the last of 11 pre-incident selection events; storage slot 2 and the exploit trace confirm the same implementation immediately before and during the claim.
